newsitem.title: USA: Unitog acquisitions seen adding to rental revenues.
newsitem.headline: Unitog acquisitions seen adding to rental revenues.

text.p: Unitog Co said Monday it completed acquisition of two companies which will expand its uniform rental operations into Canada and add a total of about $4.5 million to annual rental revenues.

Unitog said it acquired during December the uniform rental operations and facilities of Model Uniform Rental Services Ltd located in Toronto. This acquisition will expand the company's business into Canada and add about $3.5 million in annual rental revenues.

Unitog also purchased uniform rental routes in Las Vegas, Nev., to be serviced from its recently completed production facility in that city. This purchase will add about $1 million in annual rental revenues.
Unitog provides uniforms and other rental services to a variety of industries and sells custom-designed uniforms. The company makes substantially all the uniforms it rents or sells.
Shares of Unitog closed at 26-5/8 on December 13.
